results.label: Bioschemas profiles v20250219
results.note: 32 life-science profiles in one file, generated from the Bioschemas specifications. Every single path is an sh:alternativePath over the http/https forms of a schema.org term — a complex path used not for expressiveness but to paper over a namespace split. Carries sh:severity and sh:description and NOTHING else: no datatype, no class, no maxCount, no name. The corpus's worst case for type-fact inference, by construction.

results.label: DCAT-AP 3.0.1 — generated encoding
results.note: The SAME release, second encoding: `releases/3.0.1/shacl/` is generated from the UML model, uses the `shacl:` prefix rather than `sh:`, closes every node shape, and carries sh:name + sh:description on every one of its 290 property shapes — which the hand-maintained `html/shacl/` encoding of the same spec has none of. Excluded from the headline (it is not an independent profile) but the pair is the cleanest natural experiment in the corpus: one spec, two encodings, measurably different forms.
